title: Giant interacting galaxies NGC 6872/IC 4970
caption: The interacting galaxies NGC 6872 and IC 4970, imaged by ESO's Very Large Telescope
celestial: IC 4970, NGC 6872 · constellation Pavo · about 200 million light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESO press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: A huge barred spiral shaped like an integral sign stretches diagonally across this image, with a smaller interacting galaxy just above the center. The large galaxy is NGC 6872 and its companion is IC 4970, a system almost 300 million light-years away in the southern constellation Pavo, the Peacock, imaged with FORS1 on ESO's Very Large Telescope.

From tip to tip NGC 6872 spans nearly 750,000 light-years, making it one of the largest known barred spirals. Its upper left arm is noticeably disturbed and crowded with bluish objects, many of them star-forming regions. That may be the result of IC 4970 recently passing through it.

To fit the whole galaxy into the camera's field, the instrument was rotated so the galaxy lies along the diagonal. The bright object at lower right is a star in the Milky Way, badly overexposed and showing multiple reflections within the telescope and instrument.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (6.83 x 6.83 arcminutes) and distance (200 million light years), the frame spans roughly 397,000 × 397,000 light-years. Its light set out about 200 million years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: FORS1 on the VLT's ANTU unit combined blue (B), green-yellow (V) and red (R) exposures into a three-color composite.
understand.eye: Long exposures reveal the faint outer arms and distant galaxies beyond the reach of the eye.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

explore: Many fainter, more distant galaxies of varied shapes also fill the field. NGC 6872 is classified as type SBb and IC 4970 as type S0. The color picture was assembled from blue, green-yellow and red exposures taken with the VLT's ANTU unit.
alt: A long barred spiral galaxy shaped like an integral sign across the frame, a small companion galaxy near the center, and a bright overexposed star at lower right.
